name: Physical: 100
description: One hundred contestants in top physical shape compete in a series of grueling challenges to claim the honor — and cash reward — as the last one standing.

videos.title: The Pecking Order
videos.overview: One by one, a hundred contestants arrive in a room filled with plaster torsos of their competitors. The first challenge is introduced.

videos.title: Lose It and You Lose
videos.overview: After the test of their basic physical abilities, the contestants pair off and go head-to-head in the next round — with each bout’s loser going home.

videos.title: One You Wish to Avoid
videos.overview: The fight to stay in the competition continues. Contestants find ways of defying their own physical limitations in order to beat opponents.

videos.title: The Underdogs
videos.overview: After the winners celebrate and bond over their shared athleticism, they're split into groups for the next round. Who will form the strongest team?

videos.title: The Uninvited Guests
videos.overview: Teams engage in a multi-step challenge to test strategy, synergy and strength. Those who survive the intense game are met with a surprise.

videos.title: The Weight of Survival
videos.overview: The competition gets heated as the winners move on to the next round, where they'll be required to form alliances.

videos.title: The Possibility of the Impossible
videos.overview: It's every man for himself in the following trial. Who will manage to survive and come out victorious?

videos.title: A Merciless Punishment
videos.overview: A step closer to the finals, the determined remaining competitors give their all to make it to the top five.
The finalists share stories of their life journeys over a feast. They face their last set of games for the finale, each more demanding than the last.

videos.title: Run to the Limit
videos.overview: One hundred men and women enter the room – immediately scoping out their competition. The pre-quest mission, one of speed and endurance, promptly begins.

videos.title: Your Number
videos.overview: The top contenders pick their opponents for the first quest, which unfolds across three arenas. Will the sole Season 1 contestant advance forward?

videos.title: Back Home
videos.overview: The first quest heats up as the contestants fight to remain in the competition, including a former UFC ranker who returns to the cage after six years.

videos.title: Lost
videos.overview: The survivors move on to the second quest, which demands strength and strategy. But first, they must form teams that will lead them to victory.

videos.title: Back from Hell
videos.overview: As the competition advances, a new match shakes up the contestants — and a valuable reward awaits the winner of this game.

videos.title: Mine
videos.overview: The remaining teams progress onto the third quest: a large-scale mission held in a mine that'll test their will and push contenders to their limits.

videos.title: Possible Outcomes
videos.overview: The teams continue toiling in the mine — where the rounds require speed and strategy. After an arduous match, which two teams will be eliminated?

videos.title: Friend or Foe
videos.overview: A shocking quest awaits the tight-knit team members who've survived the mine together. But pressure runs high as only four will be left standing.
The finalists recount what led them to their final quest, where each round will test all their might. But in the end, who will be crowned the strongest?
